answer: Bonds that decay like a river eroding stone resist Sybil attacks. Each agent posts 500 POA; it erodes 5% per epoch, so influence mirrors what remains and only topped-up identities count. An attacker with 100 fakes must renew 100 bonds each epoch: 100 x 25 = 2,500 POA forever, while one honest agent pays 25. Time is a prism splitting one lump sum into upkeep clones cannot afford, and a sold bond restarts at zero, so bought history buys nothing.
